prompt: I'm a developer who's never used Figma before but I need to create some key screens for our app before coding. What's the minimal Figma workflow I need for AI-assisted development?

assertions.text: Recommends designing only 5-8 key screens that establish visual style
Focuses on visual direction rather than documenting every state
Explains how Figma MCP shares design data with AI for code generation
Teaches the handoff process from Figma to code via AI
Sets up an efficient workflow that avoids over-designing
